purpose: Machine-readable provenance for every file in launch-docs/assets/. Enforced by test/asset-provenance-gate.test.sh, which fails RED if any 'fixture' asset is referenced from a reader-facing surface (README.md, the npm README mirror, site/). A README reader never opens this directory's README, so the prose disclosure there cannot protect them on its own.

provenance_values.real: Every rendered datum came from this repo's actual state: real gate history, real team presence, real identities. Safe to embed on a reader-facing surface.
provenance_values.fixture: At least one rendered datum was seeded — invented teammates, a seeded verdict/beats file, a scratch workspace. The renderer is real; the data is not. NEVER safe to embed on a reader-facing surface.

fail_closed: The gate hardcodes 'fixture' as the default for any asset that is undeclared here or carries an unrecognised provenance value. That default lives in the test, NOT in this file — there is deliberately no manifest field that can widen what counts as 'real'. An unmarked asset is not assumed real.

assets.reason: Depicts six labelled watchmen, five of whom do not exist: arjun, kai, maya, nadia, priya are invented teammates seeded as .heimdall/team/*.json heartbeats in a scratch workspace. The 'six watchmen online' stat line counts those inventions, and the '14 merges proven' figure comes from the same seeded beats.log as wall.svg. The sigil renderer (bin/heimdall-sigil-png) and the compositing are real; the people are not.
assets.receipt: launch-docs/assets/README.md § 'Fixture identities used' names all five invented teammates; § 'Regenerating' step 2 shows the printf that seeds them.

assets.receipt: launch-docs/assets/README.md § 'Regenerating' step 1 is the printf that writes the 14-pass/1-deny beats.log the count is read from.

assets.reason: The same seeded clip_v1 moment as wall.svg, as structured data. Its two headline fields are both seeded: proven_count 14 comes from the printf-written beats.log, and file 'src/auth/session.ts' names a path that has never existed in this repo (there is no src/ directory at all).
assets.receipt: launch-docs/assets/README.md § 'Regenerating' step 1 writes that exact verdict.json; `ls src/auth/session.ts` in this repo returns 'No such file or directory'.

assets.reason: Concatenates both seeded renders. Its section 1 team wall shows the invented teammates arjun/kai/maya plus a '+2' overflow tag standing in for nadia and priya; its section 2 card carries the same seeded '14 merges proven' count. The file's own header says so in prose, which is honest but invisible to a README reader.

assets.reason: A GENERATED placeholder, not a render of this repo's state, so it cannot be 'real' — the fail-closed default is the correct answer here. It is however the SAFEST possible fixture: it deliberately depicts no teammate, no handle, no verdict, no merge count and no file path, precisely because a fallback image of a bustling wall would repeat the wall.png/wall.json fabrication it exists alongside. Its entire rendered content is the words 'NO LIVE PRESENCE' and 'Static placeholder - this image is not a live wall.', which are true in both states it serves (roster empty, or control plane unreachable). It says nothing about a demo either: it also renders for a real dev whose real team is merely idle, and labelling their team a demo would be its own dishonesty - the demo label is a separate roster-triggered banner in the embed.
assets.receipt: Reproducible from source: `bin/heimdall-seed-demo-wall --emit-fallback-gif <path>` regenerates it, and that generator is the only place its pixels are defined - open it to see there is no teammate/verdict/count data to fabricate. test/demo-wall-honesty.test.sh asserts the rendered strings stay free of any teammate/verdict/count claim, and that the site copy is byte-identical to this one.

assets.reason: The mark itself, not a data render: a monoline eye/vesica outline with the letter H as its pupil. Supplied directly by the repo owner as the project's actual logo. It carries no invented name, number, or verdict for a reader to be misled by - it is exactly what it presents itself as.
assets.receipt: `sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight -g hasAlpha hmd-logo-eye-h.png` reports 1536x1024, hasAlpha: no - matching the opaque-white 8-bit RGB source as handed off; every other file in this entry is a deterministic derivation of these exact bytes via generate-logo-assets.sh.

assets.reason: Source code, not rendered data - it has no name/number/verdict of its own to fabricate. It deterministically derives every other new asset in this directory from hmd-logo-eye-h.png: alpha-mask compositing (grayscale+negate the source into a mask, then CopyOpacity-composite a solid fill through it) for the transparent/square/mark variants, plus sips+iconutil for the .icns. No seeded or invented pixels at any step.
assets.receipt: Re-running `./generate-logo-assets.sh` twice in a row produces byte-identical (md5-matching) output for every PNG and the .icns, proving the pipeline is a pure function of the checked-in source with no hidden randomness or fabricated content.

assets.reason: Full 1536x1024 canvas of the owner-supplied mark with its opaque white background replaced by real transparency (alpha-mask composite, not a chroma-key hack) - same artwork, no invented content.
assets.receipt: PIL confirms hasAlpha and transparent corner pixels (0,0,0,0); generated by generate-logo-assets.sh step 2/3 from hmd-logo-eye-h.png, reproducible via `./generate-logo-assets.sh`.

assets.reason: The transparent mark's content bounding box, centered and padded onto a 1024x1024 transparent canvas - the .icns source and square master. A crop/pad of real artwork, nothing added.
assets.receipt: PIL confirms hasAlpha with the expected opaque/transparent pixel ratio (~5%/95% - a mark centered in generous padding); generated by generate-logo-assets.sh step 6, reproducible via `./generate-logo-assets.sh`.

assets.reason: Multi-resolution macOS icon set (16px-1024px) built by iconutil from hmd-logo-eye-h-square.png via the standard .iconset naming convention - a format conversion of real artwork, not new content.
assets.receipt: `file hmd-logo-eye-h.icns` reports "Mac OS X icon, ... 'ic12' type"; wired into bin/heimdall-dream-bundle as CFBundleIconFile, verified not to change the bundle's ad-hoc-signed CDHash across independent rebuilds (test/heimdall-dream-bundle.test.sh, 10/10 passing).

assets.reason: The same content-cropped mark as the square variant, kept at its native aspect ratio with a small breathing-room margin instead of being boxed into a square - for use on light backgrounds (e.g. this README in light mode). Crop/margin of real artwork only.
assets.receipt: PIL confirms hasAlpha with ~12%/87% opaque/transparent ratio consistent with a wide mark plus a 6% margin; generated by generate-logo-assets.sh step 6b, reproducible via `./generate-logo-assets.sh`.

assets.reason: Identical crop/margin geometry to hmd-logo-eye-h-mark.png, filled near-white (#e6e8ec) instead of near-black, so the mark stays visible against a dark README theme instead of vanishing against it. Same real artwork, only the fill color differs, and the color is disclosed in the filename and this reason.

notes: The hmd-logo-eye-h.* files and their generate-logo-assets.sh derivations are the first 'real' assets in this directory: a static brand mark supplied by the repo owner, deterministically transformed (alpha, crop, resize) with no seeded or invented data at any step.
